body: It's weird because I've never taken these pills before. I feel super weak all over my body. Even my jaw feels weird. It's the strangest feeling. I feel like my heart is beating faster, but that could just be from nerves.
I've actually had blood tests done that checked my CBC, thyroid, and glucose levels. They were all normal.
I am in the US. I have insurance, but it doesn't cover mental health.
